author: kkoryun
title: Windows CC build fails with compiler/linker out-of-memory errors under high parallelism
signature: Windows Release build runs out of memory - compiler fatal error C1060 (out of heap space) and linker fatal error LNK1102 (out of memory) under high parallelism|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode
failed_jobs.symptom: MSVC cl.exe hit fatal error C1060 (out of heap space) compiling op_reference/convert.cpp, then link.exe hit LNK1102 (out of memory) linking hello_query_device.exe

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_windows_cc
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregated status check failed because Build_And_Run_Collect_Mode failed

key_errors: C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\thirdparty\gtest\gtest\googletest\include\gtest/internal/gtest-internal.h(1173): fatal error C1060: compiler is out of heap space
LINK : fatal error LNK1102: out of memory
root_cause: The Windows Conditional Compilation build runs with CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 31 on a shared runner. Heavy template-instantiation-based test translation units (e.g. op_reference/convert.cpp, col2im.cpp) combined with this high parallelism exhaust available compiler/linker heap and physical memory, causing cl.exe to abort with C1060 and link.exe to abort with LNK1102. This is the same recurring infrastructure-level resource-exhaustion pattern recorded 11 times previously in this knowledge base; it is not caused by the merging PR #40023 (an NPUW dequantization-folding transformation change unrelated to the template test build), but by the ambient memory pressure of the parallel Windows Release build.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally without matching runner memory/CPU constraints. To approximate: build the `template` plugin functional tests in Release config on Windows with CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL set equal to the full logical core count (e.g. 31) on a machine with limited RAM, and observe cl.exe/link.exe failing with C1060/LNK1102 while compiling heavy template-instantiation test files under src/plugins/template/tests/functional/op_reference/.
recommended_actions: Lower CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL for the Windows CC Release build (or switch to a job-count heuristic based on available RAM per core, e.g. 1 job per 2GB) to reduce peak memory usage.
Split heavy template-instantiation test translation units (e.g. op_reference/convert.cpp, col2im.cpp) into smaller compilation units to reduce per-TU memory footprint.
Consider increasing the Windows CC runner's memory/swap allocation given this is the 11th recorded occurrence of the same OOM signature.
Investigate whether /d2:FH4 or precompiled headers could reduce memory per compilation for the template functional test target.
prevention_strategies: Track peak memory usage during Windows CC builds and alert before OOM thresholds are reached; cap parallelism explicitly per job rather than using cores-count-derived defaults; periodically audit template-heavy test files for compile-time/memory cost and refactor the worst offenders.
historical_context: This exact signature has recurred 11 times (first seen 2026-11-03, most recently 2026-11-18/19) always on the Windows CC / Windows Release build job, always C1060 out-of-heap-space and/or LNK1102 out-of-memory under CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=31. No fix has been applied yet; this remains an open, unresolved infrastructure issue.
